method.normalization: all horizontal distances are divided by head-to-trunk length; lengthHeight uses ground-to-top height
method.clustering: deterministic k-means, k=4, standardized features: hoodShare, cabinShare, rearShare, wheelbaseShare, frontOverhangShare, rearOverhangShare
method.note: clusters are geometric evidence, not final product taxonomy

quality.note: height is a relative side-view proportion; repeated canvas values are valid when the markup intentionally uses the same convenient scale
